title: Eclipse lunar parcial visible en la mayor parte de México.
text: Un eclipse lunar parcial ocurrió entre el 27 y el 28 de agosto de 2026.​ Fue el segundo y último eclipse lunar del año. El 96% de la cara visible de la Luna entró en la umbra de la Tierra, lo que permitió observarla con tonos rojizos causados por la dispersión de Rayleigh, a pesar de que no alcanzó la fase de totalidad.

title: Una estudiante inmigrante de nacionalidad española es asesinada con arma blanca en Cuautla, Morelos.
text: Un arma blanca o punzocortante​ es aquella arma o herramienta que se caracteriza por su capacidad de herir con cortes e incisiones. Se caracteriza asimismo por empuñarse en combate, y, por lo tanto, se usa en pelea cuerpo a cuerpo, aunque alguna puede ser un arma arrojadiza.

text: Juchitán de Zaragoza is an indigenous town in the southeast of the Mexican state of Oaxaca. It is part of the Juchitán District in the west of the Istmo de Tehuantepec region.

text: Mexico's has the 13th largest exclusive economic zone with a total surface area of 3,269,386 km2, and places Mexico among the countries with the largest areas in the world. title: National Electoral Institute contracting scandal: Guadalupe Taddei announces her resignation as president of the National Electoral Institute amid allegations of malfeasance.
text: The National Electoral Institute contracting scandal is a corruption scandal at Mexico's National Electoral Institute over the institute's purchases of electoral materials. It broke in October 2026 and led to the resignation of the INE's president, Guadalupe Taddei.

title: Former TV host Inés Gómez Mont is arrested in Miami by the FBI on charges of corruption, embezzlement, fraud and money laundering. Gómez Mont had been on the run since 2021.
text: Inés Gómez-Mont Arena is a Mexican television host, journalist and model. She was the host of TV Azteca's Los 25+ and co-host of Ventaneando.

title: 2026 Amputee Football World Cup
text: The 2026 Amputee Football World Cup will be the 20th edition of the biannual international competition of amputee football national men's teams. It is organized by the World Amputee Football Federation and will be held in San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico.
